method: Independent static source and pinned Mathlib v4.33.0 API review only.

change.scope: Proof body only; statements and parameters unchanged.
change.description: After unfold rowGenerating, replace higher-order exact hasSum_sum application with apply hasSum_sum; intro j hj; simpa only [spectralTerm] using the existing calibrated HasSum multiplied by x^j.

phase_checks: exists_norm_mul_eq_self provides a * norm(1-q) = 1-q; exists_norm_eq_mul_self provides norm(q) = b*q. The rw sequence yields the required affine alignment.
norm_of_nonneg applies to norm(1-q)+norm(q); its result equals ellipseRadius q by commutativity. q=0 and q=1 are covered by the inspected unconditional APIs.
At ellipse radius greater than one, phase=1 contradicts the maximizing norm; cancellation by x-1 therefore establishes affine injectivity.
Dominant phase specialization retains explicit calibration and radius>1 premises and obtains attainment from SpectralTail.
integration_checks: D.rowGenerating_eq_sum_add_remainder H N x has the exact finite-head-plus-complement shape used by expansion.
D.norm_remainder_le H x r (zero_le_one.trans hr1) hr N matches the root generic complement affine-factor bound.
The tail field spectralRemainder D.node H x has type Nat -> Complex and does not require finite spectral support.
Finite exceptional localization, maximum membership, filtered nondominant strict bounds, and common finite max bound have consistent inequality directions.
Repeated identical nodes group into a positive natural multiplicity times a nonzero complex node, so the distinguished grouped coefficient cannot vanish.
Finset.equivFin, Fintype.sum_equiv, Finset.sum_finset_coe and Finset.sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to signatures agree with the inspected pinned reference files.
residual_limitations: All three candidate modules still require the user native Lean 4.33.0 compilation and axiom audit.
Definitional reductions through local lets, Finset coe/subtypes and finiteExponentialSum have been reviewed but not elaborated by Lean here.
The existing ActualSpectralCalibration premise remains; this review does not establish its analytic power-sum input, RH, or a finite terminating-checker witness.
